mapper.select: SELECT ID, INSTANCE_ID, NODE_CODE, NODE_NAME, NODE_ORDER, STATUS, REQUIRED_ROLE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_USER_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, STARTED_TIME, COMPLETED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_APPROVAL_NODE WHERE INSTANCE_ID = #{instanceId} ORDER BY NODE_ORDER

SELECT D.ID AS PROJECT_ID, D.BUDGET_APPROVAL_ID AS PROJECT_CODE, D.PROCUREMENT_NAME AS PROJECT_NAME, D.AMOUNT AS BUDGET_AMOUNT, I.ID AS INSTANCE_ID, I.STATUS AS INSTANCE_STATUS, N.ID AS NODE_ID, N.NODE_CODE, N.NODE_NAME, N.REQUIRED_ROLE_CODE, N.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID, N.ASSIGNEE_NAME, N.STARTED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_APPROVAL_NODE N INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT_APPROVAL_INSTANCE I ON I.ID = N.INSTANCE_ID INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT_DEMAND D ON D.ID = I.PROJECT_ID WHERE N.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND N.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID = #{userId} AND I.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND D.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY N.STARTED_TIME, N.ID
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_APPROVAL_NODE ( ID, INSTANCE_ID, NODE_CODE, NODE_NAME, NODE_ORDER, STATUS, REQUIRED_ROLE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_USER_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, STARTED_TIME, COMPLETED_TIME ) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{row.instanceId}, #{row.nodeCode}, #{row.nodeName}, #{row.nodeOrder}, #{row.status}, #{row.requiredRoleCode}, #{row.assigneeUserId}, #{row.assigneeName}, #{row.startedTime}, #{row.completedTime})
